description: CV expander for CHAN-OUT, giving voltage control of its level, pan, drive and character

params.text: Attenuverter on the level CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the pan CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the drive CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the character CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added

inputs.text: Shifts the output level on CHAN-OUT, ±10V covering 66dB with the attenuverter fully open, added to the VOLUME knob and clamped to -60dB to +6dB
Shifts the pan on CHAN-OUT, ±10V covering hard left to hard right with the attenuverter fully open, added to the PAN knob and clamped to that range
Shifts the drive on CHAN-OUT, ±10V covering 0% to 100% with the attenuverter fully open, added to the DRIVE knob and clamped to that range
Shifts the character on CHAN-OUT, ±10V covering 0% to 100% with the attenuverter fully open, added to the CHAR knob and clamped to that range

notes: The module does nothing unless CHAN-OUT is immediately to its left.
Every attenuverter is at 0% when the module is added, so all four jacks do nothing until one is turned up.
The drive and character jacks change nothing while CHAN-OUT is on its Standard engine in Master Output mode, which is how it is added.
The dots either side of the X in the title fade from white to amber once CHAN-OUT is found on the left.
